name: resume_jd
description: Job description vs resume. Needs date reasoning (2021-present = 3+ years), related-but-different tech (Docker vs Kubernetes, Celery/Redis vs RabbitMQ/Kafka) and a weaker leadership claim.

requirements.text: Candidate has 3+ years of professional Python experience.
Candidate has experience with FastAPI or Django.
Candidate has experience writing unit and integration tests with pytest.
Candidate has a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Candidate has experience with message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
Candidate has experience building RAG or LLM-powered features.
requirements.evidence: embeddings, pgvector and LLM structured output

requirements.text: Candidate has experience leading a team of at least 3 engineers.
